STEP 1 - Scene: plated lunch/dinner, grilled fish or chicken, greens salad, corn/couscous-like yellow grain, black beans, cherry tomatoes.

STEP 2 - Vessel: square white plate ~26 cm side; treat as dinner plate, diameter 26 cm.
Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 = 531 cm^2

STEP 3 - Items:
- grilled fish fillets (2 pieces, top)
- grilled meat/chicken pieces (right)
- black beans
- mixed leafy salad with creamy dressing (lower left)
- yellow grain (couscous/corn), with green bits
- cherry tomatoes (3)
- green pepper/cucumber pieces

STEP 4 - Area:
- fish fillets 16% = 85 cm^2
- meat pieces 10% = 53 cm^2
- black beans 6% = 32 cm^2
- salad greens w/ dressing 22% = 117 cm^2
- yellow grain 12% = 64 cm^2
- cherry tomatoes 5% = 27 cm^2
- cucumber/pepper pieces 3% = 16 cm^2
Sum = 74% of vessel covered

STEP 5 - Volume (height):
- fish 85 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 128 ml
- meat 53 x 1.5 = 80 ml
- beans 32 x 1.2 = 38 ml
- salad 117 x 2.5 = 293 ml
- grain 64 x 1.5 = 96 ml
- tomatoes 27 x 2.0 = 54 ml
- cucumber/pepper 16 x 1.0 = 16 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- fish 128 x 0.9 = 115 g
- meat 80 x 0.95 = 76 g
- beans 38 x 0.9 = 34 g (cooked beans, dense)
- salad 293 x 0.15 = 44 g
- grain 96 x 0.8 = 77 g
- tomatoes 54 x 0.6 = 32 g
- cucumber/pepper 16 x 0.6 = 10 g
Total ≈ 388 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- fish 115 g x 150 kcal/100g = 173 kcal
- meat 76 g x 200 = 152 kcal
- beans 34 g x 130 = 44 kcal
- salad with dressing 44 g x 60 = 26 kcal
- grain 77 g x 150 = 116 kcal
- tomatoes 32 g x 18 = 6 kcal
- cucumber/pepper 10 g x 20 = 2 kcal
Total ≈ 519 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: ~390 g and ~520 kcal fits a three-quarters-covered dinner plate with protein, grain, beans and salad.
